WITH top3 AS (
    SELECT id, City
    FROM (
        SELECT b.id,
               b.City,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.City ORDER BY b.Height DESC) AS rn
        FROM "buildings" b
    )
    WHERE rn <= 3
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.name AS company_name, t.City
FROM top3 t
JOIN "Office_locations" ol ON ol.building_id = t.id
JOIN "Companies" c ON c.id = ol.company_id;

WITH TopBuildings AS (
    SELECT b.City,
           b.id AS building_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.City ORDER BY b.Height DESC) AS rn
    FROM buildings b
)
SELECT DISTINCT tb.City
FROM TopBuildings tb
INNER JOIN Office_locations ol ON tb.building_id = ol.building_id
WHERE tb.rn <= 3

WITH tallest AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "City" ORDER BY "Height" DESC) AS rn
    FROM "buildings"
  )
  WHERE rn <= 3
)
SELECT DISTINCT b."City"
FROM tallest b
JOIN "Office_locations" ol ON ol."building_id" = b."id";

WITH top_buildings AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM (
        SELECT id, City, Height,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY City ORDER BY Height DESC) AS rn
        FROM buildings
    )
    WHERE rn <= 3
)
SELECT DISTINCT c."Headquarters" AS "Headquarters"
FROM top_buildings tb
JOIN Office_locations ol ON ol.building_id = tb.id
JOIN Companies c ON c.id = ol.company_id;

WITH RankedBuildings AS (
    SELECT 
        id,
        City,
        Height,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY City ORDER BY Height DESC) as rank_in_city
    FROM "buildings"
)
SELECT DISTINCT c."Headquarters"
FROM RankedBuildings rb
JOIN "Office_locations" ol ON rb.id = ol."building_id"
JOIN "Companies" c ON ol."company_id" = c.id
WHERE rb.rank_in_city <= 3

WITH ranked_buildings AS (
  SELECT
    b."id" AS building_id,
    b."City",
    b."Height",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b."City" ORDER BY b."Height" DESC) AS rn
  FROM "buildings" b
)
SELECT DISTINCT c."Headquarters"
FROM ranked_buildings rb
JOIN "Office_locations" ol ON ol."building_id" = rb.building_id
JOIN "Companies" c ON c."id" = ol."company_id"
WHERE rb.rn <= 3;
}

WHERE b."City" = 'Mexico City'
